back_translation: “Now you, son of man, take a brick, place it before you, and engrave on it a city—Jerusalem.
Then lay siege against it: build a siege wall against it, raise up an earthen ramp against it, set up camps around it, and place battering rams around it.
Take an iron plate and set it up as an iron wall between you and the city. Turn your face toward it so that it is under siege, and besiege it. This will be a sign to the house of Israel.
Then lie on your left side and place the iniquity of the house of Israel upon yourself; you will bear their iniquity for the number of days you lie on your side.
For I have assigned to you the number of days of their iniquity, 390 days, according to the number of years of their iniquity; so you will bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
When you have completed those days, lie down a second time on your right side, and bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days; I have assigned you a day for each year.
Turn your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with your arm bared, and prophesy against the city.
Behold, I will tie you with ropes so that you cannot turn from one side to the other until you have completed the days of your siege.

As for you, take wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, put them together in one container, and make them into bread for yourself; you are to eat it throughout the 390 days you lie on your side.
The food you eat is to be weighed out at twenty shekels a day; you are to eat it at set times.
And the water you drink is to be measured out at a sixth of a hin a day; you are to drink it at set times.
You are to eat that food like a barley cake, baking it over dried human excrement before their eyes.”
Then the LORD said, “This is how the Israelites will eat their defiled food among the nations to which I will banish them.”

Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD, behold, I have never defiled myself; from my youth until now I have never eaten an animal that died of itself or one torn by beasts, and no unclean meat has ever entered my mouth.”
So He said to me, “Look, I permit you to use cow dung instead of human excrement, and you may bake your food over it.”
Then He said to me, “Son of man, behold, I am going to cut off the supply of food in Jerusalem; they will eat bread rationed by weight in anxiety, and drink water by measure in dismay,
so that they lack food and water; everyone will be appalled, wasting away in their iniquity.
